privacy: Everything published here is original learning material: explanations, equations written in LaTeX, diagrams, simulations, questions and code.
No documents are hosted on or downloadable from this site, and none are embedded in it.
Your progress, bookmarks and quiz history are stored in your own browser (or your private account when signed in) and are never shared with other visitors.
No tracking or analytics scripts are used.
